description: Iceberg water is a very unique product, in a superior category all by itself. It is an all natural, truly pure water with no traces of minerals. Its unmistakable taste is clean and light. This water’s journey started over 15,000 years ago in the ancient glaciers of western Greenland. It has been safely stored in the ice cap, protected by the ocean and the hazardous conditions of the arctic weather. Isolation has made its source totally inaccessible to man. It is not until massive pieces of ice break off into the ocean in the form of icebergs that they can be harvested. Icebergs are melted and bottled under strict quality conditions in order to preserve the water’s natural qualities. Production can be limited due to extended winters and the harsh conditions of the North Atlantic. Harvesting icebergs is a dangerous task. They are very unstable, shift frequently and can roll over in seconds, which make the possibility of drinking iceberg water an accomplishment in itself. The glass bottle displays the distinguished Berg design with a frosted finish and unique elegance.

description:
AquaBotanical is water sourced entirely from fruit and vegetables. It is an Australian award-winning and globally patented innovation that helps fresh produce growers minimise food and water wastage. Our story is more a scientific than romantic one, but it has an exciting twist that we are very proud of.

Fruit and vegetables naturally contain water. Australian farmers grow copious amounts of fresh produce to guarantee a daily supply that feeds families all over the country. Some harvests are more generous than others and not all fruit and vegetables can be sold in the fresh produce market. Being aware of how much it takes to grow this perfectly fine food, many Australian farmers choose to bring their overabundance of produce to juice manufacturers. That is where AquaBotanical’s story starts…

When fruit and vegetables are pressed to extract their juices, they produce a large volume of water in parallel. In a drought stricken country like Australia every drop is valued, but until recently the aqueous liquid from juice was not re-useable. At AquaBotanical we had to find a way to help the world tap into this unique new water source. It didn’t go unnoticed… Our water won the 2015 Food Industry Innovation Award and was the only Australian finalist at the Global Bottled Water Awards!

AquaBotanical is made by filtering and mineralising the aqueous liquid from juice concentrate. The end result is a clear and clean tasting water free of sugars, toxins and additives. We only add some subtle carbonation to our sparkling water. AquaBotanical has body and finesse without the salty or acidic after-taste of many mineral waters. Our water complements fine food and wines without overpowering any pairing.

Our proprietary source is located on the slopes of Mauna Loa, in the district of Puna, which in Hawaiian means "spring water".Treat yourself to the sweet, refreshing water of Hawai'i's Big Island. Naturally filtered and infused with electrolytes and nutrients, with minimal human processing, rehydrating yourself never was so satisfying! Billions of gallons of rainwater fall on Mauna Loa, travel downhill and percolate through nature’s ideal filter: 13,000 feet porous lava. description: Here is our history: High on the south slope of California’s San Bernardino Mountains, the home of Arrowhead’s first cold-water spring, is a remarkable slice of the natural world. Hot springs bubble up from the Earth’s surface. Caves can be found filled with steam. Several cold-water streams carry some of the world’s most delicious pure spring water from the mountains above. An arrowhead-shaped rock formation, several acres in size, points to these springs. According to a Native American legend, an arrow from heaven burned the formation on the mountainside to show tribes where they could be healed. During the mid-nineteenth century, “Dr.” David Noble Smith claimed that a saint-like being appeared before him and told of a far-off land with exceptional climate and curative waters, marked by a gigantic arrowhead. Smith’s search for that unique arrowhead formation began in Texas, and eventually ended at Arrowhead springs in California in 1857. By 1889, word of the springs, along with a hotel on the site — and belief of the effect of the water from the springs on health — had grown considerably. Hotel guests often raved about the crystal-clear water from the cold springs, which prompted Seth Marshall to set up a bottling operation in the hotel’s basement. By 1905, water from the cold springs was being shipped to Los Angeles.

description: Here is our history: High on the south slope of California’s San Bernardino Mountains, the home of Arrowhead’s first cold-water spring, is a remarkable slice of the natural world. Hot springs bubble up from the Earth’s surface. Caves can be found filled with steam. Several cold-water streams carry some of the world’s most delicious pure spring water from the mountains above. An arrowhead-shaped rock formation, several acres in size, points to these springs. According to a Native American legend, an arrow from heaven burned the formation on the mountainside to show tribes where they could be healed. During the mid-nineteenth century, “Dr.” David Noble Smith claimed that a saint-like being appeared before him and told of a far-off land with exceptional climate and curative waters, marked by a gigantic arrowhead. Smith’s search for that unique arrowhead formation began in Texas, and eventually ended at Arrowhead springs in California in 1857. By 1889, word of the springs, along with a hotel on the site — and belief of the effect of the water from the springs on health — had grown considerably. Hotel guests often raved about the crystal-clear water from the cold springs, which prompted Seth Marshall to set up a bottling operation in the hotel’s basement. By 1905, water from the cold springs was being shipped to Los Angeles.

description:
At RAMBLER, we set out to build a truly responsible water company. That starts by using only sustainable sources and making them better through a sincere focus on quality filtration techniques. Water shouldn’t weigh on our conscience. We use sustainable sources that have been pre-selected for drinking water so we’re never tapping sensitive supplies. Our premium Texas limestone filtration process balanced with the perfect level of carbonation results in a complex flavor you can’t put your finger on but keep coming back to. In addition, we package in aluminum cans over glass bottles for infinite recycle-ability and maximum compatibility with ice chests, campsites, swimming holes & beaches. But our commitment to conservation can’t stop there. It’s why we partner with programs like American Rivers and Texas Parks & Wildlife Foundation at the local level across the country to help preserve natural areas in our backyard and yours.

En RAMBLER, nos propusimos construir una compañía de agua verdaderamente responsable. Eso comienza utilizando solo fuentes sostenibles y mejorándolas a través de un enfoque sincero en técnicas de filtración de calidad. El agua no debería pesar en nuestra conciencia. Utilizamos fuentes sostenibles que han sido preseleccionadas para el agua potable para que nunca aprovechemos suministros sensibles. Nuestro proceso premium de filtración de piedra caliza de Texas equilibrado con el nivel perfecto de carbonatación da como resultado un sabor complejo al que no puedes poner el dedo pero sigue volviendo. Además, empaquetamos en latas de aluminio sobre botellas de vidrio para una capacidad de reciclaje infinita y máxima compatibilidad con pechos de hielo, campings, hoyos de natación y playas. Pero nuestro compromiso con la conservación no puede detenerse allí. Es por eso que nos asociamos con programas como American Rivers y Texas Parks & Wildlife Foundation a nivel local en todo el país para ayudar a preservar áreas naturales en nuestro patio trasero y el suyo.

Wir bei Rambler haben uns darauf gemacht, ein wirklich verantwortungsvolles Wasserunternehmen aufzubauen. Dies beginnt durch die Verwendung von nachhaltigen Quellen und macht sie besser durch einen aufrichtigen Fokus auf hochwertige Filtrationstechniken. Wasser sollte unser Gewissen nicht belasten. Wir verwenden nachhaltige Quellen, die für Trinkwasser vorausgewählt wurden, so dass wir niemals empfindliche Versorgungen anzapfen. Unser Premium-Kalkstein-Filtrationsprozess mit dem perfekten Niveau der Karbonation führt zu einem komplexen Geschmack, den Sie nicht mit Ihren Fingern tragen können, aber immer wieder zurückkommen. Darüber hinaus verpacken wir Aluminiumdosen über Glasflaschen für unendliche Recycling-Fähigkeit und maximale Kompatibilität mit Eiskisten, Campingplätzen, Schwimmlöchern und Stränden. Aber unser Engagement für den Erhalt kann dort nicht aufhören. Deshalb kooperieren wir mit Programmen wie American Rivers und Texas Parks & Wildlife Foundation auf lokaler Ebene des ganzen Landes, um dabei zu helfen, natürliche Gebiete in unserem Hinterhof und Ihrem zu erhalten.

ב-RAMBLER, התכוננו לבנות חברת מים אחראית באמת. זה מתחיל באמצעות שימוש רק במקורות ברי קיימא והופך אותם לטובים יותר באמצעות דגש כנה על טכניקות סינון איכותיות. המים לא צריכים לשקול על המצפון שלנו. אנו משתמשים במקורות ברי קיימא שנבחרו מראש עבור מי שתייה כך שאנחנו אף פעם לא מקישים על אספקה רגישה. תהליך סינון אבן גיר טקסס פרימיום שלנו מאוזן עם רמת הגבון המושלמת מביא טעם מורכב שלא תוכלו לשים את האצבע שלכם אבל המשיכו לחזור אליו. בנוסף, אנו אורזים בפחיות אלומיניום מעל בקבוקי זכוכית עבור יכולת מחזור אינסופית והתאמה מקסימלית עם שידות קרח, אתרי קמפינג, חורי שחייה וחופים. אבל המחויבות שלנו לשימור לא יכולה לעצור שם. זו הסיבה שאנחנו משתפים פעולה עם תוכניות כמו נהרות אמריקאים וקרן טקסס פארקים וחיות בר ברמה המקומית ברחבי המדינה כדי לעזור לשמר אזורים טבעיים בחצר האחורית שלנו ובשלכם.

bullet_point: [Sparkling Natural Water, Plant Based, Made from 100% Fruit & Vegetables]
description:
AquaBotanical is water sourced entirely from fruit and vegetables. It is an Australian award-winning and globally patented innovation that helps fresh produce growers minimise food and water wastage. Our story is more a scientific than romantic one, but it has an exciting twist that we are very proud of.

Fruit and vegetables naturally contain water. Australian farmers grow copious amounts of fresh produce to guarantee a daily supply that feeds families all over the country. Some harvests are more generous than others and not all fruit and vegetables can be sold in the fresh produce market. Being aware of how much it takes to grow this perfectly fine food, many Australian farmers choose to bring their overabundance of produce to juice manufacturers. That is where AquaBotanical’s story starts…

When fruit and vegetables are pressed to extract their juices, they produce a large volume of water in parallel. In a drought stricken country like Australia every drop is valued, but until recently the aqueous liquid from juice was not re-useable. At AquaBotanical we had to find a way to help the world tap into this unique new water source. It didn’t go unnoticed… Our water won the 2015 Food Industry Innovation Award and was the only Australian finalist at the Global Bottled Water Awards!

AquaBotanical is made by filtering and mineralising the aqueous liquid from juice concentrate. The end result is a clear and clean tasting water free of sugars, toxins and additives. We only add some subtle carbonation to our sparkling water. AquaBotanical has body and finesse without the salty or acidic after-taste of many mineral waters. Our water complements fine food and wines without overpowering any pairing.

description: n the hills just south of Rome, lies the small medieval town of Fiuggi The obscure conglomerate of stone buildings gained renown as early as the 1300s, when Pope Boniface VIII claimed his kidney stones had been healed by the mineral waters that gushed forth from the nearby Fiuggi spring. Two centuries later they relieved Michelangelo of what he called "the only kind of stone I couldn't love." Soon the miraculous acqua di Fiuggi was being sent in bottles to all of Europe's royalty. Fiuggi water gushes out from two thermal baths and one of these: the Boniface VIII Spring is where Italians go to “take the water”. The fountains from which healing spring water is obtained are set within a large park. Locals and tourists alike used the surroundings as a meeting place for centuries to chat and discuss the news as they sip from the spring. Fiuggi water is a natural, oligomineral water that pervades tufaceous (calcareous and siliceous rock deposits) hollows beneath the spas of Fiuggi. Fiuggi is prescribed in Italy for expulsion of kidney stones, and supposedly inhibits their formation; it is also prescribed during preparation urinary calculosis procedures and post-op treatment. description:
AquaBotanical is water sourced entirely from fruit and vegetables. It is an Australian award-winning and globally patented innovation that helps fresh produce growers minimise food and water wastage. Our story is more a scientific than romantic one, but it has an exciting twist that we are very proud of.

Fruit and vegetables naturally contain water. Australian farmers grow copious amounts of fresh produce to guarantee a daily supply that feeds families all over the country. Some harvests are more generous than others and not all fruit and vegetables can be sold in the fresh produce market. Being aware of how much it takes to grow this perfectly fine food, many Australian farmers choose to bring their overabundance of produce to juice manufacturers. That is where AquaBotanical’s story starts…

When fruit and vegetables are pressed to extract their juices, they produce a large volume of water in parallel. In a drought stricken country like Australia every drop is valued, but until recently the aqueous liquid from juice was not re-useable. At AquaBotanical we had to find a way to help the world tap into this unique new water source. It didn’t go unnoticed… Our water won the 2015 Food Industry Innovation Award and was the only Australian finalist at the Global Bottled Water Awards!

AquaBotanical is made by filtering and mineralising the aqueous liquid from juice concentrate. The end result is a clear and clean tasting water free of sugars, toxins and additives. We only add some subtle carbonation to our sparkling water. AquaBotanical has body and finesse without the salty or acidic after-taste of many mineral waters. Our water complements fine food and wines without overpowering any pairing.

description: n the hills just south of Rome, lies the small medieval town of Fiuggi The obscure conglomerate of stone buildings gained renown as early as the 1300s, when Pope Boniface VIII claimed his kidney stones had been healed by the mineral waters that gushed forth from the nearby Fiuggi spring. Two centuries later they relieved Michelangelo of what he called "the only kind of stone I couldn't love." Soon the miraculous acqua di Fiuggi was being sent in bottles to all of Europe's royalty. Fiuggi water gushes out from two thermal baths and one of these: the Boniface VIII Spring is where Italians go to “take the water”. The fountains from which healing spring water is obtained are set within a large park. Locals and tourists alike used the surroundings as a meeting place for centuries to chat and discuss the news as they sip from the spring. Fiuggi water is a natural, oligomineral water that pervades tufaceous (calcareous and siliceous rock deposits) hollows beneath the spas of Fiuggi. The scientific effect is a filtering action that purifies and reduces mineralization in the water, while creating a potent diuretic chemistry. Fiuggi is prescribed in Italy for expulsion of kidney stones, and supposedly inhibits their formation; it is also prescribed during preparation urinary calculosis procedures and post-op treatment. In all, there's little question that Fiuggi is beneficial for the kidneys and urinary tract, and it is also effective against uric acid in general, which is the basis of gout and uratic arthropathies. The water has a very acidic pH of 6.8 and a very low TDS of 122. Fiuggi was the official water of JUBILEE 2000, and it is rumored to be the choice at the Vatican.

The Tuscan Taste of Harmony
The Acqua Panna source is located 3.700 feet high in the Apennine Mountains of Tuscany, to the north of Florence. Perfectly balanced, light and luminous with a tonic note, Acqua Panna has the rare ability to enhance even the most delicate flavours. A fascinating nature that mirrors the earth of Tuscany from which it flows.
Acqua Panna encompasses the very essence of Tuscan lifestyle, heritage and fine elegance, an extraordinary water rooted in the heart of the Italian culinary, artistic and historical tradition. Known for its remarkable limpidness and freshness, with subtle but very pleasant flavours, Acqua Panna natural mineral water flows from the Apennines Mountains inside the very heart of the picturesque Tuscan landscape.
Here, sheltered by uncontaminated nature since Renaissance times, it continues to surface in all its purity, in a perfect setting, as it has done for centuries. Bottled at the source, Acqua Panna reaches the finest tables around the world as pure as it came from its springs.

There is a place in the Tuscan hills where nature, history, the harmonious beauty and natural products of excellent quality coexist smoothly: water gushes lightly, clear and bright. This place exists, is in Panna.

description: Iceberg water is a very unique product, in a superior category all by itself. It is an all natural, truly pure water with no traces of minerals. Its unmistakable taste is clean and light. This water’s journey started over 15,000 years ago in the ancient glaciers of western Greenland. It has been safely stored in the ice cap, protected by the ocean and the hazardous conditions of the arctic weather. Isolation has made its source totally inaccessible to man. It is not until massive pieces of ice break off into the ocean in the form of icebergs that they can be harvested. Icebergs are melted and bottled under strict quality conditions in order to preserve the water’s natural qualities. Production can be limited due to extended winters and the harsh conditions of the North Atlantic. Harvesting icebergs is a dangerous task. They are very unstable, shift frequently and can roll over in seconds, which make the possibility of drinking iceberg water an accomplishment in itself. What's the difference between Mineral, Spring and Purified Water?

MINERAL WATER
Mineral water originates from a geologically and physically protected underground water source, flows to the surface unaided or is pumped, and naturally contains at least 250 parts per million (ppm) of total dissolved solids (TDS). The minerals in Crystal GeyserSparkling Mineral Water are naturally occurring.
SPRING WATER
Spring water also originates from a protected underground formation, but must flow to the surface of the earth unaided. Spring water may naturally contain minerals, but only meets the definition of mineral water if it contains at least 250 TDS.

Crystal GeyserWater Company was founded in 1977 in California. For 40 years, we’ve stayed true to our commitment to purity, quality and time-honored traditions. Proudly sourced and bottled in the USA, our mission is clear: to provide your family with the best tasting sparkling water.

PURITY, PERFECTED
Why is Crystal Geyser Sparkling Water the best sparkling water in the world? Our founders spent more than a year painstakingly studying geological survey maps, exploring water sources, and performing countless taste tests before finding what they believe is the perfect water. Our highest priority is to preserve and maintain our water’s refreshing, natural character.

When the bottle gets recycled, it goes on to become tissues, paper towels, even building materials!

JUST Water

Founded by Jaden Smith and his passion for a cleaner, safer environment, every choice we make at JUST Water is considered, from where our spring water comes from, to the materials that are used to make our eco-friendly carton. What's the difference between Mineral, Spring and Purified Water?

MINERAL WATER
Mineral water originates from a geologically and physically protected underground water source, flows to the surface unaided or is pumped, and naturally contains at least 250 parts per million (ppm) of total dissolved solids (TDS). The minerals in Crystal GeyserSparkling Mineral Water are naturally occurring.
SPRING WATER
Spring water also originates from a protected underground formation, but must flow to the surface of the earth unaided. Spring water may naturally contain minerals, but only meets the definition of mineral water if it contains at least 250 TDS.

OUR HISTORY
Crystal GeyserWater Company was founded in 1977 in California. For 40 years, we’ve stayed true to our commitment to purity, quality and time-honored traditions. Proudly sourced and bottled in the USA, our mission is clear: to provide your family with the best tasting sparkling water.

PURITY, PERFECTED
Why is Crystal Geyser Sparkling Water the best sparkling water in the world? Our founders spent more than a year painstakingly studying geological survey maps, exploring water sources, and performing countless taste tests before finding what they believe is the perfect water. Our highest priority is to preserve and maintain our water’s refreshing, natural character.

description:
AquaBotanical is water sourced entirely from fruit and vegetables. It is an Australian award-winning and globally patented innovation that helps fresh produce growers minimise food and water wastage. Our story is more a scientific than romantic one, but it has an exciting twist that we are very proud of.

Fruit and vegetables naturally contain water. Australian farmers grow copious amounts of fresh produce to guarantee a daily supply that feeds families all over the country. Some harvests are more generous than others and not all fruit and vegetables can be sold in the fresh produce market. Being aware of how much it takes to grow this perfectly fine food, many Australian farmers choose to bring their overabundance of produce to juice manufacturers. That is where AquaBotanical’s story starts…

When fruit and vegetables are pressed to extract their juices, they produce a large volume of water in parallel. In a drought stricken country like Australia every drop is valued, but until recently the aqueous liquid from juice was not re-useable. At AquaBotanical we had to find a way to help the world tap into this unique new water source. It didn’t go unnoticed… Our water won the 2015 Food Industry Innovation Award and was the only Australian finalist at the Global Bottled Water Awards!

AquaBotanical is made by filtering and mineralising the aqueous liquid from juice concentrate. The end result is a clear and clean tasting water free of sugars, toxins and additives. We only add some subtle carbonation to our sparkling water. AquaBotanical has body and finesse without the salty or acidic after-taste of many mineral waters. Our water complements fine food and wines without overpowering any pairing.

description: Enjoy hawaiian springs water (2x6pack). Pure and fresh arctic moisture travels thousands of miles on the trade winds to hawaii, the most isolated land mass on earth. Converted to bountiful rain or snow as it hits the slopes of mauna loa, the water percolates through nature's ideal filter - 13, 000 feet of newly formed porous lava. From rainfall to bottle in about 30 days, the short journey of this young water allows it to be naturally alkaline with a ph of 7. 7, while maintaining a low mineral content of 91 tds (total dissolved solids). The taste has been described as fresh, smooth with a hint of natural sweetness by consumers. The mountains of the big island of hawaii create a virtually inexhaustible source by capturing almost 200 inches of rain per year, making the aquifer one of the most renewable sources of water on earth, refiling at 117 million gallons per day. The labels of the packaging feature three endemic hawaiian flowers - the ko'oloa 'ula, the nanu and the 'ohia lehua. The ko'oloa 'ula is sometimes known as the 'red llima' or 'the flowering maple' and both it and the nanu are endangered. The 'ohia lehua is an essential food source for endangered hawaiian birds, and is the signature flower of the big island, home to the source. Hawaiian springs gives to the nature conservancy in hawaii and partners with other organizations like the plant extinction prevention program in preserving hawaii's unique environment. What's the difference between Mineral, Spring and Purified Water?

MINERAL WATER
Mineral water originates from a geologically and physically protected underground water source, flows to the surface unaided or is pumped, and naturally contains at least 250 parts per million (ppm) of total dissolved solids (TDS). The minerals in Crystal GeyserSparkling Mineral Water are naturally occurring.
SPRING WATER
Spring water also originates from a protected underground formation, but must flow to the surface of the earth unaided. Spring water may naturally contain minerals, but only meets the definition of mineral water if it contains at least 250 TDS.

Crystal GeyserWater Company was founded in 1977 in California. For 40 years, we’ve stayed true to our commitment to purity, quality and time-honored traditions. Proudly sourced and bottled in the USA, our mission is clear: to provide your family with the best tasting sparkling water.

미네랄, 스프링, 정제수의 차이점은 무엇입니까?

미네랄 워터.
미네랄 워터는 지질학적 및 물리적으로 보호되는 지하수원에서 유래하여 원조되지 않은 표면으로 흐르거나 펌핑되며, 자연적으로 총 용해성 고형물(TDS) 만 (ppm) 당 최소 250개의 부품을 포함하고 있습니다. 크리스탈 간헐천의 미네랄은 자연적으로 발생합니다.
스프링 워터
샘물은 또한 보호받는 지하 형성에서 유래되지만 원조되지 않은 지구 표면으로 흘러야 합니다. 샘물에는 자연적으로 미네랄이 포함될 수 있지만 최소 250 TDS가 함유된 경우에만 미네랄 워터의 정의를 충족합니다.

우리의 역사
Crystal GeyserWater Company는 1977년 캘리포니아에서 설립되었습니다. 40년 동안 당사는 순도, 품질 및 오랜 전통에 대한 헌신에 충실했습니다. 미국에서 자랑스럽게 공급되고 병에 든 당사의 사명은 분명합니다. 가족에게 최고의 맛의 탄산수를 제공하는 것입니다.

순수함, 완벽함
왜 Crystal Geyser 스파클링 워터가 세계 최고의 탄산수일까요? 창립자들은 1년 이상 지질 조사 지도를 공들여 연구하고, 수원을 탐색하고, 수많은 맛 테스트를 수행하여 완벽한 물이라고 믿는 것을 찾기 전에 했습니다. 저희의 최고 우선 순위는 물의 상쾌하고 자연스러운 특성을 보존하고 유지하는 것입니다.

description: Here is our history: High on the south slope of California’s San Bernardino Mountains, the home of Arrowhead’s first cold-water spring, is a remarkable slice of the natural world. Hot springs bubble up from the Earth’s surface. Caves can be found filled with steam. Several cold-water streams carry some of the world’s most delicious pure spring water from the mountains above. An arrowhead-shaped rock formation, several acres in size, points to these springs. According to a Native American legend, an arrow from heaven burned the formation on the mountainside to show tribes where they could be healed. During the mid-nineteenth century, “Dr.” David Noble Smith claimed that a saint-like being appeared before him and told of a far-off land with exceptional climate and curative waters, marked by a gigantic arrowhead. Smith’s search for that unique arrowhead formation began in Texas, and eventually ended at Arrowhead springs in California in 1857. By 1889, word of the springs, along with a hotel on the site — and belief of the effect of the water from the springs on health — had grown considerably. Hotel guests often raved about the crystal-clear water from the cold springs, which prompted Seth Marshall to set up a bottling operation in the hotel’s basement. By 1905, water from the cold springs was being shipped to Los Angeles.

description: The foundation of Scarperia, whose original name was Castel San Barnaba, dates back to 1306 at the behest of the Florentine Republic; the name became Scarperia because of its geographical position, that is, at the foot of the shoe. A Scarperia in those times along the main street were located craft activities necessities such as laboratories and workshops where they worked the iron and produced agricultural tools and knives. Processing and sale of knives and of Cutting characterized the productive activities Scarperia and, soon, this craft became one of the elements of expertise and reputation of the country, still known today as the "Land of Cutting Tools". In 1415 Scarperia became also the seat of the Vicariate and assumed administrative functions delegated by the Florentine Republic. The Palace, built as a fortress, turned into residence of the Vicar, hence the name "Palazzo dei Vicari" where in addition to architectural works, the frescoes and the heralds you can admire the clock by Filippo Brunelleschi, a unique jewel in his Typically, restored thanks to the contribution of the Group Sanpellegrino.

description: Elderflower Cordial 500ml. Belvoir's original cordial made from fresh-picked elderflowers and lemon juice, this timeless mix has a wide array of applications, including white wine, sparkling water, gin and tonic, fruit salad, sorbet or even a hot toddy. Handmade drinks from the heart of the countryside Belvoir Fruit Farms nestles deep in the English countryside in the idyllic Vale of Belvoir. Weve been making cordials here for nearly 30 years, pressing fresh fruit and infusing flowers to mix with the famous Belvoir spring water. Renowned for our elderflower drinks, we still use the same elderflower recipe developed by co-founder Mary Manners all those years ago. Originally, all the elderflowers were handpicked from bushes growing around Lord and Lady John Manners garden. The whole family helped to make the first batch of elderflower cordial, chopping the lemons and stirring the syrup. Lord John then popped the 88 cases of drinks into the back of his car and went round local farm shops, persuading the owners to buy a bottle here and there. Today, demand is so high that Belvoir calls on the local community to help with the harvest, picking flowers from our own orchards and from hedgerows in the surrounding countryside. To achieve the unique taste of Belvoirs elderflower products, its essential to use nothing but fresh flowers. Peverel Manners, Lord Johns son, says: The secret of a really good elderflower cordial is to use masses of flowers that have been picked in the sunshine when they're warm and heavy with yellow pollen, then get them into the vat within three hours. This gives the drink its delicate floral taste. Over the years, the company has expanded its beverage range to include a wide range of flavors and the brand now produces more than 40 products, many of which have won multiple awards. Belvoir Fruit Farms is still owned and run by the Manners family.

description: At VOSS, we are proud of the quality of our products. VOSS Artesian Water from Norway meets all bottled water standards for quality and safety at the U.S. Federal, State, Norwegian and International levels. Our scientists and independent certified laboratories perform extensive tests on the water source and finished bottled water product to ensure we exceed or are compliant with all bottled water requirements. VOSS is a pure artesian water from Norway that's bottled at its source. Though Norway is a small country, its pristine environment produces some of the best spring and artesian water sources on Earth. VOSS comes from an aquifer in Southern Norway, protected from air and other pollutants for centuries by impermeable layers of rock and sand. The water is generated in an artesian spring within deep bedrock. When tapped into, the aquifer is pressurized enough to allow the water to rise up naturally towards the surface, then bottled at the source without undergoing filtration. The high quality of VOSS is controlled by analytical tests. These tests verify that the water is not contaminated in any way. Analytical tests are performed frequently at the source to verify the constancy of the mineral composition. Though Norway is a small country, its pristine environment produces some of the best spring and artesian water sources on Earth, and most Norwegians see it as a national benefit to live off this pure tasting drinking water. Ole and Christopher knew instinctively that bottling pure Norwegian artesian water would be a big hit with discerning consumers around the world.

description:
When you crack open a can and hear the natural bubbles pop, you know you're in for the unique flavor of nature that only Borjomi (pronounced Bor-zho-mi) brings. Instilled by the Earth with moderate carbonation and a wonderfully bold and intense mineral flavor incomparable to anything else, it's easy to understand why many people love it and are hooked for life. However, due to the high natural volcanic mineral content, only 1 in 2 people can actually handle Borjomi's intensity. But if you enjoy soda water and club soda or like to add mineral drops for water to your plain seltzer, you may also enjoy this naturally mineral-packed fizzy water!

The long history of Borjomi includes stories of the masses and historical figures alike enjoying its benefits by soaking in the region's spas or drinking the natural mineral water in bottles. When visiting the USSR, Winston Churchill required Borjomi to be placed next to him on the table. The astronaut Yuri Gagarin’s first request upon returning from space was a bottle of Borjomi. The famous director Giorgi Tovstonogov required a bottle of Borjomi to be prepared for him ahead of all theater rehearsals. Clearly, this is no ordinary natural water.

So what is it that makes Borjomi so desired and loved? The work that's done by our beautiful planet to yield a delicious product with natural minerals of volcanic origin, making it so famous that people flock to it.

Water from the Borjomi Gorge springs located in the Caucasus Mountains of the country of Georgia is only canned in quantities naturally produced to ensure this precious resource is around for generations to come. In 130 years of collection, the mineral content remains unchanged, evidence supporting that this ecologically-friendly method ensures proper resource use, never abuse.

description:
Why HOP WTR Was Created
We made HOP WTR for people like us: overachievers trying to balance work and play, gym and kids, while still finding time to kick back with a cold one.

But having a little fun shouldn’t come at the expense of hard work (or looking good). We tried every beer alternative on the market but never felt fully satisfied.

We wanted a product that could be a healthy alternative to beer. All the taste and feeling without hangovers. Relaxation and fun without consequences. Staying healthy and focused without feeling like the killjoy at the party.

Sounds like a paradox, but as innovative entrepreneurs committed to fitting fun into the jam packed workweek, we figured out how to fill the gap.

And so HOP WTR was born. Citrusy, piney, aromatic hops brewed with bubbly, fresh sparkling water to create a beer alternative that cuts the crap without sacrificing flavor.

Our Ingredients
No sugar, no alcohol, no gluten, no calories. AKA no hangovers, no gut, no stress, and no problems.

Our unique blend of Columbus and Centennial dry hops is concocted with bold bubbles and feel-good adaptogens and nootropics to emulate the stress-relieving, thirst-quenching taste and feel of your favorite IPA.

Benefits without the booze. Powered by L-Theanine and ashwagandha, our brew will leave you feeling refreshed even after you take your last sip.

HOP WTR Flavors
For a traditional, hoppy homage to your favorite IPA, try our Classic brew. Mango will have your mouth cresting tropical waves on a far-off island, while Blood Orange will have you riding away into the Spanish sunset with a breeze blowing through your hair.

And keep your eye out for our new addition, Lemon Lime, coming soon to zest up your weekday.

description:
Imagine the sweet citrusy flavor of lemon and orange paired with Perrier's sparkling bubbles. That’s Perrier lemon orange, a refreshing variation on the beverage that has delighted consumers for over 150 years. Perrier lemon orange is wonderful on its own, but its delightful citrus twist makes it the perfect partner for cocktails and drink recipes. Originating in France, Perrier's effervescent spirit is known worldwide. The Perrier collection also offers a great alternative to carbonated soft drinks, with no sugar and zero calories. It’s the ideal at-home or on-the-go beverage, making it a refreshing choice for every day.

Imagina el dulce sabor cítrico de limón y naranja emparejado con las burbujas espumosas de Perrier. Esa es la naranja limón Perrier, una refrescante variación en la bebida que ha encantado a los consumidores durante más de 150 años. La naranja limón Perrier es maravillosa por sí sola, pero su delicioso toque cítrico lo convierte en el compañero perfecto para cócteles y recetas de bebidas. Originario de Francia, el espíritu efervescente de Perrier es conocido en todo el mundo. La colección Perrier también ofrece una gran alternativa a los refrescos carbonatados, sin azúcar ni calorías. Es la bebida ideal en casa o en la marcha, por lo que es una opción refrescante para todos los días.

דמיינו את טעם הדרים המתוק של לימון ותפוז בשילוב עם בועות נוצצות של Perrier. זה תפוז לימון Perrier, וריאציה מרעננת על המשקה שמהנה את הצרכנים במשך למעלה מ-150 שנה. תפוז לימון Perrier הוא נהדר בפני עצמו, אבל טוויסט הדרים המענג שלו הופך אותו לשותף המושלם לקוקטיילים ומתכוני משקה. שמקורו בצרפת, הרוח התוססת של פרייר ידועה ברחבי העולם. קולקציית Perrier מציעה גם חלופה נהדרת למשקאות קלים מוגזים, ללא סוכר ואפס קלוריות. זהו המשקה האידאלי בבית או בדרכים, מה שהופך אותו לבחירה מרעננת לכל יום.

Stellen Sie sich den süßen zitrusigen Geschmack von Zitrone und Orange gepaart mit Perriers funkelnden Blasen. Das ist Perrier Zitronenorange, eine erfrischende Variante des Getränks, die seit über 150 Jahren Verbraucher begeistert. Perrier Zitronenorange ist wunderbar für alleine, aber seine entzückende Zitrusdrehung macht es zum perfekten Partner für Cocktails und Getränkerezepte. Der in Frankreich stammende Brausetgeist von Perrier weltweit bekannt. Die Perrier Kollektion bietet auch eine tolle Alternative zu kohlensäurehaltigen Softdrinks, ohne Zucker und ohne Kalorien. Es ist das ideale Getränk zu Hause oder unterwegs und ist somit eine erfrischende Wahl für jeden Tag.

تخيل النكهة الحمضية الحلوة لليمون والبرتقال مع فقاعات بيرير المتلألئة. هذا هو برتقال الليمون من بيريه، وهو اختلاف منعش على المشروبات التي تسعد المستهلكين لأكثر من 150 عام. يعتبر برتقال الليمون من بيريه رائعًا بمفرده، ولكن ملمسه المبهج بالحمضيات يجعله الشريك المثالي للكوكتيل ووصفات المشروبات. نشأت بروح بيريير الفعالة في فرنسا، وهي معروفة في جميع أنحاء العالم. كما توفر مجموعة بيريه بديلاً رائعًا للمشروبات الغازية الكربونية، بدون سكر أو سعرات حرارية. إنه المشروب المثالي في المنزل أو أثناء التنقل، مما يجعله خيارًا منعشًا كل يوم.

Imagine o doce sabor cítrico de limão e laranja juntamente com as bolhas brilhantes da Perrier. Essa é a laranja limão Perrier, uma variação refrescante na bebida que encantou os consumidores há mais de 150 anos. A laranja-limão Perrier é maravilhosa por conta própria, mas seu encantador toque cítrico torna o parceiro perfeito para coquetéis e receitas de bebidas. Originário na França, o espírito efervescente da Perrier é conhecido em todo o mundo. A coleção Perrier também oferece uma ótima alternativa aos refrigerantes gaseificados, sem açúcar e sem calorias. É a bebida ideal para usar em casa ou em movimento, o que a torna uma escolha refrescante para todos os dias.

bullet_point: [Ferrarelle is among the very few naturally carbonated waters in the world, Perfect accompaniment for any exquisite cuisine for an extraordinary taste and natural bubbles, Delicate on the palate with a unique and soft taste, Italy's number one brand of sparkling mineral water was established in 1893, Italian Product, Italian packaging]
description:
Ferrarelle Italian Sparkling Mineral Water is the perfect accompaniment for any exquisite cuisine for an extraordinary taste and natural bubbles. Ferrarelle has carbon dioxide which is a natural gift from nature. The Natural bubbles in Ferrarelle are finer and more numerous than in water with added artificial CO2. This makes Ferrarelle Italian Sparkling Mineral Water more delicate on the palate and gives it a unique and softer taste.

When you choose Ferrarelle, you can be sure of its high quality. Everyone who drinks Ferrarelle knows it: it is a water that is bottled just as nature produced it. Ferrarelle is a naturally sparkling mineral water. Using sensors, we monitor the subterranean and surface water-bearing stratum for a correct control of the water resources and to ensure that the quantity of CO2 in the water at the spring is the same as in every bottle of Ferrarelle water. Moreover, Ferrarelle is the first and only mineral water that can at present boat SGS certification as to the natural origins of its effervescence; a proof of quality guaranteeing the 100% natural origins of its bubbles.

How the natural effervescence is born
Ferrarelle water becomes effervescent when it encounters the natural gas of an ancient and now-extinct volcano as it passes through the uncontaminated depths of the earth. The drops of rain fall on the Roccamonfina volcano and penetrate into the ground. Tricking through the pyroclastic flows, the water is purified and is enriched with mineral salts, including silica and potassium. Then it drops through the deeper limestone strata and there is enriched with magnesium, calcium and bicarbonate. It is during this underground process that the carbon dioxide is dissolved in the water and gives it that delicately fizzy taste that makes it unique. The process is a touch of magic that has lasted thousands of years and which man has bottled since 1893.

What's the difference between Mineral, Spring and Purified Water?

MINERAL WATER
Mineral water originates from a geologically and physically protected underground water source, flows to the surface unaided or is pumped, and naturally contains at least 250 parts per million (ppm) of total dissolved solids (TDS). The minerals in Crystal GeyserSparkling Mineral Water are naturally occurring.
SPRING WATER
Spring water also originates from a protected underground formation, but must flow to the surface of the earth unaided. Spring water may naturally contain minerals, but only meets the definition of mineral water if it contains at least 250 TDS.

OUR HISTORY
Crystal GeyserWater Company was founded in 1977 in California. For 40 years, we’ve stayed true to our commitment to purity, quality and time-honored traditions. Proudly sourced and bottled in the USA, our mission is clear: to provide your family with the best tasting sparkling water.

PURITY, PERFECTED
Why is Crystal Geyser Sparkling Water the best sparkling water in the world? Our founders spent more than a year painstakingly studying geological survey maps, exploring water sources, and performing countless taste tests before finding what they believe is the perfect water. Our highest priority is to preserve and maintain our water’s refreshing, natural character.

description:
What is a Shrub?
The American version of the shrub has its origins in 17th century England where vinegar was used as an alternative to citrus juices in the preservation of berries and other fruits for the off-season. By the 19th century, typical American recipes for shrubs used vinegar poured over fruit—traditionally berries—which was left to infuse anywhere for several days; afterwards, the fruit would be strained out and the remaining liquid would be mixed with a sweetener such as sugar. The sweet-and-sour syrup could be mixed with either water or soda water and served as a soft drink, or as a mixer in alcoholic cocktails.

The Horball's Difference
We care about quality – quality ingredients, quality manufacturing, and quality flavors. When a customer buys a Horball’s product, they know that the finest, freshest ingredients were curated into a magnificently tasting product. We don't skimp on the packaging either... you won't find plastic bottles and chintzy screw caps - sturdy glass bottles and high quality branding draw attention to a bottle of Horball's on the shelf.

And if for any reason you don’t like it – tell us why and we will help you get a different flavor to try out!

What drinks can you make with a shrub?
This is one of the questions we get the most: you can make almost any kind of drink with a shrub. Sweet, sour, tangy, refreshing, bubbly. With or without alcohol. Just combine 1oz of your favorite shrub with soda, a liquor, or follow one of our recipes. If you come up with an awesome recipe, share it with us! If your recipe is really good, we will post it on our website and have competitions with prizes!

Hot springs bubble up from the Earth’s surface. Caves can be found filled with steam. Several cold-water streams carry some of the world’s most delicious pure spring water from the mountains above. An arrowhead-shaped rock formation, several acres in size, points to these springs. According to a Native American legend, an arrow from heaven burned the formation on the mountainside to show tribes where they could be healed. During the mid-nineteenth century, “Dr.” David Noble Smith claimed that a saint-like being appeared before him and told of a far-off land with exceptional climate and curative waters, marked by a gigantic arrowhead. Smith’s search for that unique arrowhead formation began in Texas, and eventually ended at Arrowhead springs in California in 1857. By 1889, word of the springs, along with a hotel on the site — and belief of the effect of the water from the springs on health — had grown considerably. Hotel guests often raved about the crystal-clear water from the cold springs, which prompted Seth Marshall to set up a bottling operation in the hotel’s basement. By 1905, water from the cold springs was being shipped to Los Angeles.

description:
De-ionized water, simply put, is water that has had almost all of its mineral ions removed. Cations such as sodium, calcium, iron, and copper, while anions like chloride and sulfate, are removed from the water via one of any number of deionization methods, which can be a chemical or an electrical process. Regardless of the method, the majority of the impurities in the water are dissolved salts, and removing them through deionization produces water with a high purity. Our de-ionized water is guaranteed to have a minimum specificity of 12 megohm-cm resitivity, which places it higher than the NCCLS standard of 10 megohm-cm.

description: n the hills just south of Rome, lies the small medieval town of Fiuggi The obscure conglomerate of stone buildings gained renown as early as the 1300s, when Pope Boniface VIII claimed his kidney stones had been healed by the mineral waters that gushed forth from the nearby Fiuggi spring. Two centuries later they relieved Michelangelo of what he called "the only kind of stone I couldn't love." Soon the miraculous acqua di Fiuggi was being sent in bottles to all of Europe's royalty. Fiuggi water gushes out from two thermal baths and one of these: the Boniface VIII Spring is where Italians go to “take the water”. The fountains from which healing spring water is obtained are set within a large park. Locals and tourists alike used the surroundings as a meeting place for centuries to chat and discuss the news as they sip from the spring. Fiuggi water is a natural, oligomineral water that pervades tufaceous (calcareous and siliceous rock deposits) hollows beneath the spas of Fiuggi. The scientific effect is a filtering action that purifies and reduces mineralization in the water, while creating a potent diuretic chemistry. Fiuggi is prescribed in Italy for expulsion of kidney stones, and supposedly inhibits their formation; it is also prescribed during preparation urinary calculosis procedures and post-op treatment. In all, there's little question that Fiuggi is beneficial for the kidneys and urinary tract, and it is also effective against uric acid in general, which is the basis of gout and uratic arthropathies. The water has a very acidic pH of 6.8 and a very low TDS of 122. Fiuggi was the official water of JUBILEE 2000, and it is rumored to be the choice at the Vatican.

What's the difference between Mineral, Spring and Purified Water?

MINERAL WATER
Mineral water originates from a geologically and physically protected underground water source, flows to the surface unaided or is pumped, and naturally contains at least 250 parts per million (ppm) of total dissolved solids (TDS). The minerals in Crystal GeyserSparkling Mineral Water are naturally occurring.
SPRING WATER
Spring water also originates from a protected underground formation, but must flow to the surface of the earth unaided. Spring water may naturally contain minerals, but only meets the definition of mineral water if it contains at least 250 TDS.

Lemon Infused Pure Spring Water

We popped the cap and infused organic lemon with our spring water to create a light, refreshing flavored water that tastes as if you had just placed fresh lemons in the bottle.

Eco-Friendly, Sustainable & Renewable Bottled Water

Our lemon infused spring water is supplied in a 100% plant based bottle, which is made from renewable and recyclable materials. Using plants for much of the material content in the water bottle means a reduction in carbon emissions by up to 74% compared to average plastic bottled water. Our alkaline flavored water is bottled (or boxed?) using paper from sustainably managed forests, and the cap is made from sugar cane. Our bottle is BPA Free and has a wider neck for easier water refills.

JUST Infused is 100% pure spring water sourced from Glens Falls, NY. Utilizing just a small percentage of the abundant high-quality, high-pH drinking water, we pay a fair price and have created a fair business. All proceeds from our relationship are invested back into the city allowing us to give back with every bottle of water.

JUST Water

Founded by Jaden Smith and his passion for a cleaner, safer environment, every choice we make at JUST Water is considered, from where our spring water comes from, to the materials that are used to make our eco-friendly carton. description: Unfiltered. Untreated. Uncompromised. Hallstein is the world's only commercially available water that meets the highest quality standards. Working with a team of scientists and water experts, we established 8 core parameters and 4 other parameters for defining drinking water quality. Using their criteria we began testing a large number of waters in laboratories. The results were eye-opening, they revealed that there wasn’t a single commercially available drinking water that met their criteria for “high quality”, except Hallstein. Hallstein Water is sourced from an an artesian aquifer, 700ft (214m) deep in a layer of rock beneath Obertraun, in the Hallstatt region of Upper Austria. The water in the aquifer arrives there after an 8-year journey beginning as raindrops in the mountains above, then filtering through layers of the highest quality limestone. Protected from pollution by a level of earth called a Glacial Moraine, the aquifer is an incredibly natural source of water.

VOSS Water is the vision and creation of two boyhood friends growing up in Oslo, Norway; Ole Christian Sandberg and Christopher Harlem. Distinction: With its iconic design, VOSS is served on the tables of the finest restaurants and lounges, in the rooms of the most distinctive hotels and in the homes of the most demanding water drinkers around the world. VOSS Water ist die Vision und Kreation von zwei Freunden, die in Oslo, Norwegen aufwachsen; Ole Christian Sandberg und Christopher Harlem. Ole und Christopher stimmten die Reinheit des norwegischen Wassers mit einem bahnbrechenden, ikonischen Flaschendesign auf und VOSS wurde geboren. VOSS hat drei verschiedene Markenwerte: Reinheit, Unterscheidung und Verantwortung. Reinheit: VOSS wird an einer kunsthandwerklichen Quelle im makellosen Süden Norwegen abgefüllt, wodurch ein natürlich reines Wasser, mineralarm und unvergleichlich im Geschmack entsteht. Reinheit bei VOSS beginnt mit unserem Wasser und fließt bis zu den reinen Absichten unserer Menschen. Besonderheit: Mit seinem ikonischen Design wird VOSS auf den Tischen der besten Restaurants und Lounges, in den Räumen der unverwechselbarsten Hotels und in den Häusern der anspruchsvollsten Wassertrinker auf der ganzen Welt serviert. Verantwortung: VOSS ist stolz auf sein ständiges Engagement für die Voss Foundation, mit der Mission den Zugang zu reinem, sauberem Trinkwasser zu den Gemeinden zu bieten, ist Sub-Sahara-Afrika. Darüber hinaus engagiert sich VOSS für die Umwelt und erhält durch eine Reihe umfassender Maßnahmen 100 % CO2-Neutralität.

A VOSS Water é a visão e a criação de dois amigos da infância em Oslo, Noruega; Ole Christian Sandberg e Christopher Harlem. Ole e Christopher combinaram a pureza da água norueguesa com um design inovador, icônico de garrafa, e nasceu a VOSS. A VOSS tem três valores distintos da marca: pureza, distinção e responsabilidade. Pureza: o VOSS é engarrafado em uma fonte artesiana no sul da Noruega, produzindo uma água naturalmente pura, baixa em minerais e sabor incomparável. A pureza na VOSS começa com nossa água e flui até as intenções puras do nosso povo. Distinção: Com seu design icônico, a VOSS é servida nas mesas dos melhores restaurantes e lounges, nos cômodos dos mais distintos hotéis e nas casas dos mais exigentes bebedores de água em todo o mundo. Responsabilidade: A VOSS orgulha-se de seu compromisso contínuo com a Fundação Voss, com a missão de fornecer acesso à água potável pura e limpa às comunidades é a África Sub-Saariana. Além disso, a VOSS está comprometida com o meio ambiente, mantendo 100% de neutralidade de carbono através de um conjunto de medidas abrangentes.

VOSS Water 是兩位在挪威奧斯陸長大的男孩朋友,Ole Christian Sandberg 和 Christopher Harlem。 Ole and Christopher 採用突破性的標誌性瓶型設計,與挪威水的純度相得益彰,VOSS 誕生了。 VOSS 有三種不同的品牌價值:純度、獨特性和責任性。 純度:VOSS 在原始的挪威南部被裝瓶為藝術來源,產生天然純淨的水,礦物質低,口感無與倫比。 VOSS 的純淨始於我們的水,流入我們人民的純粹意圖。 特色:VOSS 以其標誌性設計,可在最好的餐廳和休息室的餐桌上、最獨特的酒店的房間和世界各地要求最苛刻的飲酒者的家中供應。 責任:VOSS 為其對 Voss 基金會的持續承諾感到自豪,其使命是向社區提供純淨、乾淨的飲用水是撒哈拉以南非洲。 此外,VOSS 致力於環保,通過一套全面措施保持 100% 碳中和。

VOSS Water 是两个在挪威奥斯洛成长的男朋友;Ole Christian Sandberg 和 Christopher Harlem。 Ole 和 Christopher 将挪威水纯度与突破性的标志性瓶身设计相匹配,VOSS 诞生了。 VOSS 有三个不同的品牌价值观:纯度,独特和责任。 纯度:VOSS 在挪威南部原汁原味的自流源,生产天然纯净的水,矿物质含量低,口感无可比拟。 VOSS 的纯度始于我们的水,流向我们人民的纯粹意图。 与众不同：VOSS 以其标志性的设计，在最好的餐厅和休闲厅的桌子上，以及最独特的酒店的房间和全世界最苛刻的饮水者家庭中使用。 职责:VOSS 为其对沃斯基金会持续承诺而感到自豪,向撒哈拉以后社区提供纯净、清洁饮用水。 此外,VOSS 致力于环境,通过一系列综合措施,保持 100% 碳中和。

VOSS 워터는 노르웨이 오슬로에서 자라는 두 명의 남자시절 친구의 비전과 창조물입니다. 올레 크리스찬 샌드버그와 크리스토퍼 할렘. 올레와 크리스토퍼는 노르웨이 물의 순도를 획기적인 아이코닉한 병 디자인과 매치했으며, VOSS가 탄생했습니다. VSS는 순도, 차별성, 책임의 세 가지 브랜드 가치를 가지고 있습니다. 순도: VSS는 깨끗한 남부 노르웨이의 지하수 공급원에서 병에 담겨져 미네랄이 낮고 맛은 비교할 수 없는 천연 순수한 물을 생산합니다. VSS의 순도는 우리의 물에서 시작하여 사람들의 순수한 의도대로 흐릅니다. 특징: 상징적인 디자인으로 VOSS는 최고급 레스토랑 및 라운지 테이블, 가장 독특한 호텔의 객실 및 전 세계에서 가장 까다로운 물을 마시는 사람들의 가정에서 제공됩니다. 책임: VSS는 Voss Foundation에 대한 지속적인 헌신에 자부심을 가지고 있으며, 커뮤니티에 순수하고 깨끗한 식수를 제공하는 사명으로 사하라 남부 아프리카입니다. 또한 VSS는 환경에 전념하고 있으며, 종합적인 조치를 통해 100% 탄소 중립성을 유지합니다.

description:
Ferrarelle Italian Sparkling Mineral Water is the perfect accompaniment for any exquisite cuisine for an extraordinary taste and natural bubbles. Ferrarelle has carbon dioxide which is a natural gift from nature. The Natural bubbles in Ferrarelle are finer and more numerous than in water with added artificial CO2. This makes Ferrarelle Italian Sparkling Mineral Water more delicate on the palate and gives it a unique and softer taste.

When you choose Ferrarelle, you can be sure of its high quality. Everyone who drinks Ferrarelle knows it: it is a water that is bottled just as nature produced it. Ferrarelle is a naturally sparkling mineral water. Using sensors, we monitor the subterranean and surface water-bearing stratum for a correct control of the water resources and to ensure that the quantity of CO2 in the water at the spring is the same as in every bottle of Ferrarelle water. Moreover, Ferrarelle is the first and only mineral water that can at present boat SGS certification as to the natural origins of its effervescence; a proof of quality guaranteeing the 100% natural origins of its bubbles.

How the natural effervescence is born
Ferrarelle water becomes effervescent when it encounters the natural gas of an ancient and now-extinct volcano as it passes through the uncontaminated depths of the earth. The drops of rain fall on the Roccamonfina volcano and penetrate into the ground. Tricking through the pyroclastic flows, the water is purified and is enriched with mineral salts, including silica and potassium. Then it drops through the deeper limestone strata and there is enriched with magnesium, calcium and bicarbonate. It is during this underground process that the carbon dioxide is dissolved in the water and gives it that delicately fizzy taste that makes it unique. The process is a touch of magic that has lasted thousands of years and which man has bottled since 1893.

title: Hawaiian Springs 1.5 Litre Single, 50.7-Ounce (Pack of 12)
description: Pure and fresh arctic moisture travels thousands of miles on the trade winds to Hawaii, the most isolated land mass on earth. Converted to bountiful rain or snow as it hits the slopes of Mauna Loa, the water percolates through nature's ideal filter - 13,000 feet of newly formed porous lava. From rainfall to bottle in about 30 days, the short journey of this young water allows it to be naturally alkaline with a pH of 7.7, while maintaining a low mineral content of 91 TDS (Total Dissolved Solids). The taste has been described as fresh, smooth with a hint of natural sweetness by consumers. The mountains of the Big Island of Hawaii create a virtually inexhaustible source by capturing almost 200 inches of rain per year, making the aquifer one of the most renewable sources of water on earth. The labels of the packaging feature three endemic Hawaiian flowers - the Ko'oloa 'ula, the Nanu and the 'Ohia Lehua. The Ko'oloa 'ula is sometimes known as the Red Llima or The Flowering Maple and both it and the Nanu are endangered. The 'Ohia Lehua is an essential food source for endangered Hawaiian birds, and is the signature flower of the Big Island, home to the source. Hawaiian Springs gives to the Nature Conservancy in Hawaii and partners with other organizations like the Plant Extinction Prevention Program in preserving Hawaii's unique environment.

description:
Ferrarelle Italian Sparkling Mineral Water is the perfect accompaniment for any exquisite cuisine for an extraordinary taste and natural bubbles. Ferrarelle has carbon dioxide which is a natural gift from nature. The Natural bubbles in Ferrarelle are finer and more numerous than in water with added artificial CO2. This makes Ferrarelle Italian Sparkling Mineral Water more delicate on the palate and gives it a unique and softer taste.

When you choose Ferrarelle, you can be sure of its high quality. Everyone who drinks Ferrarelle knows it: it is a water that is bottled just as nature produced it. Ferrarelle is a naturally sparkling mineral water. Using sensors, we monitor the subterranean and surface water-bearing stratum for a correct control of the water resources and to ensure that the quantity of CO2 in the water at the spring is the same as in every bottle of Ferrarelle water. Moreover, Ferrarelle is the first and only mineral water that can at present boat SGS certification as to the natural origins of its effervescence; a proof of quality guaranteeing the 100% natural origins of its bubbles.

How the natural effervescence is born
Ferrarelle water becomes effervescent when it encounters the natural gas of an ancient and now-extinct volcano as it passes through the uncontaminated depths of the earth. The drops of rain fall on the Roccamonfina volcano and penetrate into the ground. Tricking through the pyroclastic flows, the water is purified and is enriched with mineral salts, including silica and potassium. Then it drops through the deeper limestone strata and there is enriched with magnesium, calcium and bicarbonate. It is during this underground process that the carbon dioxide is dissolved in the water and gives it that delicately fizzy taste that makes it unique. The process is a touch of magic that has lasted thousands of years and which man has bottled since 1893.

description: Rose flower water (aka rose petals water) is a clear, perfumed distillation of fresh rose petal blossoms. This essential water has traditionally been used in many French and Mediterranean dessert dishes, but has more recently found its way into Western cuisine. For example, rose flower water is used in France to flavor crepes, in Mexico to flavor little wedding cakes, and in the United States to make pastry. In the Arab world, it is frequently added to hard or otherwise bad-tasting drinking water to mask the unpleasant flavor.
